questionText: Where is the stop placed? Risk sizing without stop placement cannot produce a position size.
reason: This is the risk-management source, and it still does not close the gap. It gives risk as a percentage of the account (0.5-1%, 1-2%, 3-5%) - which is the SIZE of the risk, not its LOCATION. Position size = risk amount / stop distance, and the stop distance is nowhere in six Alex G sources. **The gap narrows and remains open.** Every P&L-capable replay is still blocked.
